spans.s: शाखा f. 1. A branch, especially of a tree, Megh.i.41, Rt.i.26; 2. an arm; 3. a party, a faction; 4. a school or traditional recension of any Veda, e.g. शाकलशाखा, बाष्कलशाखा &c. M.iii.145; 5. a part or section of a work.
शाखा-चंद्रन्याय m. the maxim of the moon and a bough; it is adduced in illustration when an object has its position assigned to it from the appearance of contiguity.
शाखा-नगर, -पुर n. a suburb.
शाखा-नगर, -पुर n. a suburb.
शाखा-पित्त m. inflammation of the extremities of the body.
शाखा-भृत् m. a tree.
शाखा-भेद m. difference of Vedic school.
शाखा-मृग m. 1. a monkey; 2. a squirrel.
शाखा-रंड m. A Brāhmaṇa who has changed his Vedic school.
शाखा-रथ्या f. a branch-road.
शाखाल m. A sort of cane.
शाखिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Having branches; 2. belonging to any Vedic school.
शाखिन् (II) m. 1. A tree; 2. a follower of any Vedic school; 3. a Veda.
शाखिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Having branches; 2. belonging to any Vedic school.
शाखोट n. Name of a tree.
शाखोट n. Name of a tree.

सखि m. (nom. सखा, सखायौ, सखायः) An associate, a companion, स किंसखा साधु न शास्ति योधिपम् Kir.i.5, सखीनिव प्रीति युजोऽनुजीविनः i.10.(At the end of compounds, सखि is changed into सख, as in महिषीसखः R.i.48, K.S.i.10.)
सखी f. A female friend or companion, एताः सुतनु मुखं ते सख्यः पश्यन्ति हेमकूटगताः Vikr.i.
सख्य n. 1. Friendship, alliance, समानशीलव्यसनेषु सख्यम् Hit.i., मुमूर्च्छ सख्य रामस्य R.xii.57; 2. equality.
साख्य n. Friendship.
साखेय a. (f. यी) Belonging to a friend.
साखेय a. (f. यी) Belonging to a friend.
